data.cultural_impact: The name 'Ximenez' gained circulation in the Christian world, particularly in Spain, during the Middle Ages. During this period, Spain was under Muslim rule, and many Spanish Christians adopted disguised Christian names to hide their faith. The name 'Ximenez' and its variations may have been used to pay tribute to the biblical figure Joshua or Jesus, who represents salvation and deliverance from adversity.
